operational_proof_determination.determination_statement: The first controlled Satoshium Attestor production operation demonstrated the institution's governed end-to-end capability to accept eligible governed inputs, create a canonical Attestation, conduct Rule-Constrained Evaluation, issue a bounded Trust Statement, perform production Validation and governed Review, establish applicable Conformance, govern lifecycle independently from publication, publish canonical Attestor objects, revalidate their final governed state, preserve authority and provenance boundaries, and retain an auditable production evidence trail. Operational Proof is established.
limitations: Operational Proof establishes demonstrated institutional capability; it does not make every future Attestor operation valid, conformant, correct, or successful.
Each future Attestation, Evaluation, Trust Statement, lifecycle action, and publication remains subject to applicable Attestor governance.
Operational status does not transfer authority from referenced Suite institutions or external sources.
This determination does not expand the scope or meaning of ATT-2026-0001 or TRST-2026-0001.
operational_proof_determination.next_action: Update Attestor public status and repository-facing documentation to reflect Operational status, then record the milestone in chronology/journal and perform a final live consistency review.
